game_title: Name Tag Match – Orchard Lane Trial
game_concept: A logic puzzle set in The Kingdom – Orchard Lane, the royal orchard lane: the knight must handle thieves while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Name Tag Match: Match floating variable name tags to the values on passing scrolls before they reach thieves.
theme: The Kingdom – Orchard Lane: the royal orchard lane
core_gameplay_loop: In Orchard Lane, repeat each round: Match floating variable name tags to the values on passing scrolls before they reach thieves. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the tag_matches value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the royal seal using at most 21 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The royal seal reached with actions_used <= 21.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 21 before the royal seal is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 6 (applied tier): Name Tag Match
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Name Tag Match' (Week 1 slot 5), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Orchard Lane'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how tag_matches changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against thieves in Orchard Lane.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The royal seal reached with actions_used <= 21.
